text:
Morgan: Quick sync — regional phased deploy tonight 23:30-01:30 UTC. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Start 4% canary in us-east-2 then 10% slices. Need capacity thumbs and any emergency pins. @deploy-bot start canary when ready
deploy-bot: Launching canary: service=runtime version=v2.5.0-canary slice=us-east-2 ramp=4%
Elsa: us-east-2 warm pool 90%, cpu headroom ~25%. Good to go for 4%.
Kevin: eu-west3 warm pool 64% now. We can shift 6 nodes from reserve but that reduces backfill cushion. Recommend waiting on EU until US green.
Anjali: apac-hkg cold; warm ETA for 8 nodes ~30m. Network priming at 45%. I'd rather APAC be last and pre-warm.
Kai: Staging smoke: 180rps/12s -> p95=140ms p99=360ms, errors=0
deploy-bot: smoke output:
[smoke] 12s@180rps p50=28ms p95=139ms p99=359ms errors=0 kvcache=93%
ops-oncall: Note a brief region control-plane blip in eu-west3 earlier; watch control-plane RTT for 15m after EU cut.
Morgan: Proposal: start US canary now. Hold EU until warm pool >=70% and 10m stable. Pre-warm APAC now for 30m; abort APAC if warmup fails in 25m. Rollback triggers: error-rate>1% for 5m OR p95 increase >220ms for 3m.
Elsa: +1. I'll monitor dashboards and set alert thresholds.
Kevin: After US canary healthy, auto-pin EU to canary for 20m for phased validation. Also gate expansion if cold-start errors>0.3%.
Anjali: Kicking APAC warmup. If misses target, we'll reroute traffic to US capacity.
deploy-bot: Canary started us-east-2 at 4123678910. Monitoring hooks active.
deploy-bot: 60s snapshot -> errors=0.3% p95 delta=+8ms queues stable
ops-oncall: Runbook rollback commands:
   deploybot rollback --service runtime --version previous-stable --region <region> --force
   deploybot pin --service runtime --version previous-stable --scope global
Morgan: Final: US canary go. EU follows after warm pool>=70% and 15m stable. APAC pre-warm and timebox 45m. Documented in release notes. :thumbsup:
Anjali: Posting updates every 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary health at 4123678955 -> stable. No rollback triggered.
Morgan: Thanks team — keep posting live signals here and escalate to #incidents and @ops-oncall for any redlines.
